manuscript.title: Milne’s rationality conjecture for abelian varieties
manuscript.main_theorem: For every rational Hodge class gamma on a good-reduction abelian variety A/Qbar, and complementary Cartier divisors D_i on A_0, the specialized ℓ-adic and crystalline top-degree traces all equal one rational q for this fixed data, including residual characteristic p.
distinctions: Main theorem is rationality of common pairings, not algebraic representation of arbitrary Hodge classes.
Separate algebraicity consequence uses the CM Hodge theorem as an extra input.
No comparison between different reduction places is claimed.
